inputs.label: Nintendo 3DS games
inputs.help: Your own dumped and decrypted 3DS games, for example .3ds or .cia files.

steps.text: Open CitraVR from Library > Unknown Sources and choose /sdcard/CitraVR/roms as the games folder.

notes: The extension list comes from the payload. .cia and .zcia files are installed in the app, not shown as loose games. The repository also publishes beta and test pre-releases, which prerelease false skips.
